lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਏਕੰਕਾਰੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਭੁ ਜਗਤੁ ਜਿੰਨਿ ਉਪਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: har simar eka(n)kaar saachaa sabh jagat ji(n)n upaaiaa ||
lines.translation: Meditate in remembrance on the One Universal Creator; the True Lord created the entire Universe.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉਣੁ ਪਾਣੀ ਅਗਨਿ ਬਾਧੇ ਗੁਰਿ ਖੇਲੁ ਜਗਤਿ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: paun paanee agan baadhe gur khel jagat dikhaaiaa ||
lines.translation: The Guru controls the air, water and fire; He has staged the drama of the world.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਚਾਰਿ ਤੂ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੰਜਮ ਜਪ ਤਪੋ ॥
lines.transliteration: aachaar too veechaar aape har naam sa(n)jam jap tapo ||
lines.translation: Reflect on your own self, and so practice good conduct; chant the Name of the Lord as your self-discipline and meditation.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਖਾ ਸੈਨੁ ਪਿਆਰੁ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਜਪੁ ਜਪੋ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: sakhaa sain piaar preetam naam har kaa jap japo ||2||
lines.translation: The Name of the Lord is your Companion, Friend and Dear Beloved; chant it, and meditate on it. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਏ ਮਨ ਮੇਰਿਆ ਤੂ ਥਿਰੁ ਰਹੁ ਚੋਟ ਨ ਖਾਵਹੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: e man meriaa too thir rahu chot na khaavahee raam ||
lines.translation: O my mind, remain steady and stable, and you will not have to endure beatings.

lines.gurmukhi: ਏ ਮਨ ਮੇਰਿਆ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਵਹੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: e man meriaa gun gaavahi sahaj samaavahee raam ||
lines.translation: O my mind, singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, you shall merge into Him with intuitive ease.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ਰਾਮ ਰਸਾਇ ਰਸੀਅਹਿ ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨ ਅੰਜਨੁ ਸਾਰਹੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: gun gaai raam rasaai raseeahi gur giaan a(n)jan saarahe ||
lines.translation: Singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, be happy. Apply the ointment of spiritual wisdom to your eyes.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰੈ ਲੋਕ ਦੀਪਕੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਚਾਨਣੁ ਪੰਚ ਦੂਤ ਸੰਘਾਰਹੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: trai lok deepak sabad chaanan pa(n)ch doot sa(n)ghaarahe ||
lines.translation: The Word of the Shabad is the lamp which illuminates the three worlds; it slaughters the five demons.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭੈ ਕਾਟਿ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਤਰਹਿ ਦੁਤਰੁ ਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਕਾਰਜ ਸਾਰਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhai kaat nirabhau tarahi dutar gur miliai kaaraj saarae ||
lines.translation: Quieting your fears, become fearless, and you shall cross over the impassible world ocean. Meeting the Guru, your affairs shall be resolved.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰੂਪੁ ਰੰਗੁ ਪਿਆਰੁ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰਏ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: roop ra(n)g piaar har siu har aap kirapaa dhaarae ||3||
lines.translation: You shall find the joy and the beauty of the Lord's Love and Affection; the Lord Himself shall shower you with His Grace. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਏ ਮਨ ਮੇਰਿਆ ਤੂ ਕਿਆ ਲੈ ਆਇਆ ਕਿਆ ਲੈ ਜਾਇਸੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: e man meriaa too kiaa lai aaiaa kiaa lai jaaisee raam ||
lines.translation: O my mind, why did you come into the world? What will you take with you when you go?

lines.gurmukhi: ਏ ਮਨ ਮੇਰਿਆ ਤਾ ਛੁਟਸੀ ਜਾ ਭਰਮੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਸੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: e man meriaa taa chhutasee jaa bharam chukaaisee raam ||
lines.translation: O my mind, you shall be emancipated, when you eliminate your doubts.

lines.gurmukhi: ਧਨੁ ਸੰਚਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਵਖਰੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਭਾਉ ਪਛਾਣਹੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: dhan sa(n)ch har har naam vakhar gur sabad bhaau pachhaanahe ||
lines.translation: So gather the wealth and capital of the Name of the Lord, Har, Har; through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, you shall realize its value.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੈਲੁ ਪਰਹਰਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਮਹਲੁ ਘਰੁ ਸਚੁ ਜਾਣਹੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: mail parahar sabad niramal mahal ghar sach jaanahe ||
lines.translation: Filth shall be taken away, through the Immaculate Word of the Shabad; you shall know the Mansion of the Lord's Presence, your true home.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਘਰਿ ਸਿਧਾਵਹਿ ਝੋਲਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਪੀ ਰਸੋ ॥
lines.transliteration: pat naam paavahi ghar sidhaavahi jhol a(n)mrit pee raso ||
lines.translation: Through the Naam, you shall obtain honor, and come home. Eagerly drink in the Ambrosial Amrit.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਵਡਭਾਗਿ ਜਪੀਐ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੋ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: har naam dhiaaeeai sabad ras paaeeai vadabhaag japeeai har jaso ||4||
lines.translation: Meditate on the Lord's Name, and you shall obtain the sublime essence of the Shabad; by great good fortune, chant the Praises of the Lord. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਏ ਮਨ ਮੇਰਿਆ ਬਿਨੁ ਪਉੜੀਆ ਮੰਦਰਿ ਕਿਉ ਚੜੈ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: e man meriaa bin pauReeaa ma(n)dar kiu chaRai raam ||
lines.translation: O my mind, without a ladder, how will you climb up to the Temple of the Lord?

lines.gurmukhi: ਏ ਮਨ ਮੇਰਿਆ ਬਿਨੁ ਬੇੜੀ ਪਾਰਿ ਨ ਅੰਬੜੈ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: e man meriaa bin beRee paar na a(n)baRai raam ||
lines.translation: O my mind, without a boat, you shall not reach the other shore.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਿ ਸਾਜਨੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਗੁਰਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਲੰਘਾਵਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: paar saajan apaar preetam gurasabad surat la(n)ghaavae ||
lines.translation: On that far shore is Your Beloved, Infinite Friend. Only your awareness of the Guru's Shabad will carry you across.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਰਲੀਆ ਫਿਰਿ ਨ ਪਛੋਤਾਵਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: mil saadhasa(n)gat karahi raleeaa phir na pachhotaavae ||
lines.translation: Join the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, and you shall enjoy ecstasy; you shall not regret or repent later on.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਦਇਆ ਦਾਨੁ ਦਇਆਲ ਸਾਚਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਪਾਵਓ ॥
lines.transliteration: kar daiaa daan daiaal saachaa har naam sa(n)gat paavao ||
lines.translation: Be Merciful, O Merciful True Lord God: please give me the Blessing of the Lord's Name, and the Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਪਇਅੰਪੈ ਸੁਣਹੁ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਨੁ ਸਮਝਾਵਓ ॥੫॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: naanak paia(n)pai sunahu preetam gur sabad man samajhaavao ||5||6||
lines.translation: Nanak prays: please hear me, O my Beloved; instruct my mind through the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||5||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੁਖਾਰੀ ਛੰਤ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
lines.transliteration: tukhaaree chha(n)t mahalaa 4 ||
lines.translation: Tukhaari Chhant, Fourth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਪਿਰੀ ਪਿਆਰੁ ਕਿਉ ਪਿਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਜੀਵੀਐ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)tar piree piaar kiu pir bin jeeveeai raam ||
lines.translation: My inner being is filled with love for my Beloved Husband Lord. How can I live without Him?

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਦਰਸੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ਕਿਉ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਵੀਐ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: jab lag daras na hoi kiu a(n)mrit peeveeai raam ||
lines.translation: As long as I do not have the Blessed Vision of His Darshan, how can I drink in the Ambrosial Nectar?

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਿਉ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਵੀਐ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਜੀਵੀਐ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਰਹਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: kiu a(n)mrit peeveeai har bin jeeveeai tis bin rahan na jaae ||
lines.translation: How can I drink in the Ambrosial Nectar without the Lord? I cannot survive without Him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਪ੍ਰਿਉ ਪ੍ਰਿਉ ਕਰੇ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਪਿਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਪਿਆਸ ਨ ਜਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: anadin priu priu kare din raatee pir bin piaas na jaae ||
lines.translation: Night and day, I cry out, "Pri-o! Pri-o! Beloved! Beloved!", day and night. Without my Husband Lord, my thirst is not quenched.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਪਣੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਦ ਸਾਰਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: apanee kripaa karahu har piaare har har naam sad saariaa ||
lines.translation: Please, bless me with Your Grace, O my Beloved Lord, that I may dwell on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, forever.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਮੈ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਹਉ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਵਾਰਿਆ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: gur kai sabad miliaa mai preetam hau satigur vitahu vaariaa ||1||
lines.translation: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, I have met my Beloved; I am a sacrifice to the True Guru. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਦੇਖਾਂ ਪਿਰੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਰਸਿ ਰਵਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: jab dekhaa(n) pir piaaraa har gun ras ravaa raam ||
lines.translation: When I see my Beloved Husband Lord, I chant the Lord's Glorious Praises with love.
